new_relations.title: New state may require a transformed container
new_relations.project_anchor: The project formalizes a Narrow Door Release principle: transition can require dropping old constraints or boxes incompatible with the target state.
new_relations.biblical_structure: new wine and old wineskins illustrate that a changed content/process may require a fitting container
new_relations.source_direction: Project constraint-shedding principle first; Gospel comparison later.
